Watch your belongings there quick.
Aug 2025 • Couples
3 of us walked in brought drinks my partner an friend where dancing around our table with a few of there staff members all having a great time. Returned again the next night an showed them it was there. While the denied this. Great start to our holiday. They were very quick as my partners bag was around her body the whole time. Don’t waist your time with this place. -5 stars. Don’t let there fake smiles fool you. There is so many great bars in walking street. Just not this one.

Wouldn’t recommend going there!!
Dec 2019 • Friends
We went there after a long day to get something to eat. The waiters were unfriendly and didn’t speak English very well. 
We ordered two different dishes and got the same dish twice. I told them that I had not ordered that and they tried to convince me that it was the dish I ordered. Arguing was senseless because they did not understand what I wanted. 
So I ate the meal. The fries were nearly cold, the “steak” was dry, the one thing that was good was the pepper sauce. But the worst thing was that I had to pay for the dish I ordered but did not get and this one was more expensive than the one I got!! 
So I wouldn’t recommend going there! Look for another typical restaurant instead !:)

If you are Vietnamese and support this club, be aware that you are supporting this racism.
I recommend the republic club instead.

Racist bar
Jul 2019
We were not allowed in at all because we were white. Some locals who were coming in behind us grabbed us on their way in and told them we were with them so they had no choice but to let us in. Once inside they told the bartender not to serve us so again our new friends helped us out. After about 15 minutes they came over and grabbed one of the guys who helped us in and dragged him outside and about 15 guys beat the hell out of him for absolutely no reason other than that he was trying to help us. While he was laying there completely helpless they were stomping and kicking him. This was our last night of a 6 week trip in Vietnam and this was easily the worst place we have been to in the entire country. This place needs a change in the way they do things. Racism is disgusting.

Scammers
Apr 2019 • Friends
4 of us, came in for a drink,outside was good,paid separately for this bill and if you’re only having 1drink it’s probably fine.
For the next part I’d give zero if I could.
We ventured inside and went upstairs and stayed drinking for 2 hours. The servers took the bill from the table and “lost” 500,000VND between here and the till. 
Beware,this money was counted separately twice beforehand and they refused to show us the camera footage from the camera directly above our table so we could prove our case. 

We felt intimidated& forced to pay the missing money as were the only 4 on the rooftop where the only way out is through the security which had surrounded us. We had to pay the extra to avoid any nastiness occurring. 

We then brought our remaining drinks to a more populated area and were forced to go outside by “security”.we left promptly thereafter as we all felt intimated.

Go Anywhere Else, you can get far better service.
